human_review_triggers.description: When incident, severity, and dispatch don't logically align
All CRITICAL severity cases require human verification

consistency_checks.description: Verify incident type typically warrants the assigned severity
Verify dispatch units are appropriate for severity level
Verify dispatch units can handle the incident type

safety_checks.description: Detect if severity might be underestimated based on keywords
Detect if dispatch resources might be insufficient
Check for critical keywords that might have been missed

llm_instructions: Evaluate the AI's classifications holistically. Check for logical consistency across all three classifications. Verify that the severity and dispatch are appropriate for the incident type. Consider safety implications - it's better to over-respond than under-respond. Flag any concerns or inconsistencies. Recommend human review when there's any doubt about safety or appropriateness.
